codex.text: Tuning the confidence threshold by scoring "all threshold variants" against the *same sealed holdouts* used for the accept/reject decision converts those holdouts into a selection set—this is textbook multiple-testing overfitting, and reusing an already-burned seal for the champion's challenger compounds the contamination; there is no held-out confirmation pass after threshold selection. The 5% net-expectancy bar carries no statistical significance requirement (bootstrap or otherwise), no statement of whether it's relative to champion expectancy on identical windows, and ignores that DEMO fills make the cost assumptions optimistic rather than evidence-based. The trade-count (−20%) and drawdown tolerances are arbitrary round numbers with no pre-registered rationale, and "worsening maximum drawdown" lacks any epsilon, making the gate either trivially strict or silently discretionary. Finally, "stability gate fails → reject" is asserted without defining the stability metric, window, or false-positive handling—an unmeasurable claim dressed as a safeguard.

opencode.text: The fired-versus-skipped comparison is selection-confounded: the gate determines exposure, so skipped states may lack comparable realized exits, and fixed-horizon synthetic outcomes are not equivalent to strategy P&L. Testing many symbols and 1–10-bar horizons without a pre-registered primary endpoint, multiplicity correction, purged time splits, and a sealed holdout invites overfitting; an ordinary bootstrap also ignores serial dependence. Re-mining “positive pockets” from already inspected outcomes compounds selection bias, and “CI excluding zero” alone omits minimum effect size, sample-size, regime-stability, and drawdown gates.

proposals.text: **Proposal: Gate-validity audit — offline replay of fired-vs-skipped states.** Current evidence shows the validated-state gate is the sole binding constraint (firehose_throughput.json, 2026-08-22: 16,261/20,573 opportunities skipped, 100% with reason `state_not_in_validated_set`), yet the validated set is anchored to champion CORE_STRATEGY_V1 whose own record is net-negative (-0.027R IS / -0.019R OOS, PF 0.27) with a cosmetic 95.7% win rate (avg_win 0.031 vs avg_loss -2.57), so the gate may be filtering toward negative-expectancy states. Next cycle, run an offline replay experiment (registered in ExperimentRegistry) that scores forward net-of-cost expectancy — using the measured p75 costs already recorded per symbol, e.g. USDJPY 1.6 pips — for all logged fired states vs skipped states over fixed 1–10 bar horizons. Falsifiable prediction: if the gate adds value, fired-state expectancy exceeds skipped-state expectancy with the difference's bootstrap 95% CI excluding zero; if skipped states are equal or better, the validated set is mis-specified. In that failure case, re-mine candidate validated states from the reconciled exits' positive pockets (outcome_learning.md: USDCHF exp +0.014 n=350, USDCAD exp +0.005 n=337) instead of from CORE_STRATEGY_V1's state signature. This stays research-only — no code changes, no champion promotion, no live config touched.

Evaluate a challenger that calibrates the validated-state gate’s confidence threshold using only registered walk-forward experiments on existing DEMO data. The candidate succeeds only if, across the same sealed holdouts and cost assumptions as the champion, it improves net expectancy by at least 5% without reducing trade count by more than 20% or worsening maximum drawdown. Record all threshold variants and failures in `ExperimentRegistry`; reject the candidate if any lookahead, stability, or promotion gate fails. Do not modify code or promote the champion during this cycle.

question: The AEGIS MT5 DEMO bot is running the intelligent firehose with the validated-state gate. Given the current measured evidence, identify ONE concrete, falsifiable improvement candidate for the next research cycle. Do not modify code or the champion. Cite book corpus passages if relevant.

codex.text: Pre-register threshold variants, statistical tests, stability criteria, and risk tolerances, then select the threshold using registered walk-forward training/validation windows that exclude both previously used and fresh sealed confirmation data. Evaluate the single selected challenger once on a newly sealed, untouched DEMO window against the champion on identical observations, using conservative spread/slippage stress scenarios calibrated from available fill data and explicitly acknowledging residual DEMO-to-live uncertainty. Success requires a bootstrap 95% confidence interval for the challenger’s relative net-expectancy improvement to exclude zero and a point estimate of at least 5%, while meeting pre-justified trade-retention and maximum-drawdown non-inferiority margins, including an explicit drawdown epsilon. Define stability prospectively as acceptable dispersion and sign consistency of net expectancy across fixed walk-forward folds, with multiplicity correction and minimum fold/trade counts; record every variant, decision, and failure in `ExperimentRegistry`. Reject on any lookahead, stability, statistical, cost-stress, or promotion-gate failure, and do not modify code or promote the champion during this cycle.

opencode.text: **Proposal (rev 2): Gate-validity audit — pre-registered, purged replay of fired-vs-skipped states.** Because the gate itself determines exposure, the replay scores both arms under one identical synthetic forward-return metric (explicitly a gate-quality diagnostic, not a P&L forecast): the pre-registered primary endpoint is pooled fired-minus-matched-skipped net-of-cost expectancy at the 5-bar horizon, where every fired state is matched to nearest-neighbour skipped states on symbol/session/volatility/spread covariates, with 1–10 bar horizons demoted to a sensitivity family under Holm correction. Inference uses a moving-block bootstrap sized to one trading day to respect serial dependence and passes only if the 95% CI excludes zero AND the difference clears a pre-registered minimum effect size (≥0.05R/trade) at n≥200 per arm, with additional sign-consistency-across-quarters and max-drawdown gates. Time splits are purged and embargoed: candidate validated states are re-derived from scratch on the training window alone — outcome_learning.md's USDCHF/USDCAD pockets are treated strictly as hypothesis-generating, never as confirmatory evidence — and accepted only if they replicate on a fresh sealed holdout registered in advance. Endpoints, thresholds, split boundaries, and holdout seals are frozen in ExperimentRegistry before any replay executes; a holdout failure declares the validated set mis-specified and triggers governed re-mining, not adjustment of this experiment. Research-only throughout: no code changes, no champion promotion, no live config touched.
